pdf.intro: Thank you for your interest in our services. We are pleased to submit the following quotation for your review.
pdf.amountsInAed: All prices are in UAE dirhams (AED).
pdf.validity: This quotation is valid until {{date}}. Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions.
pdf.contact: Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions.

list.intro: Prepare a quotation, send it as a PDF on your letterhead, and record the customer's answer.
list.intro_projects: Price a job room by room, send it as a PDF on your letterhead, and record the customer's answer.
list.noMatchesHint: Try another number or name, or show all quotations.

empty.title: No quotations yet
empty.body: Make your first quotation: pick the customer, add what you'll sell, and send it as a PDF.
empty.body_projects: Make your first quotation: pick the customer, add the work room by room with pictures, and send it as a PDF.
empty.viewer: Quotations your team prepares show here.

editor.pageIntro: Nothing is sent until you send it. You can save a draft and come back.
editor.pageIntro_projects: Add the work room by room, with a picture for each item. Nothing is sent until you send it.
editor.customerLocked: A revision keeps its customer. To quote another customer, copy the quotation instead.
editor.customerRefHint: Their enquiry or LPO number, if they gave one.
editor.validUntilHint: Leave "Valid until" empty to use your usual number of days (Settings → Documents).
editor.linesHint: Type a name: your products and services show as you type. Or type anything, it stays on this quotation.
editor.linesHint_projects: Type a name: your services and work items show as you type. Or type any item, it stays on this quotation.
editor.typedOnly: You can't see your products and services, so type each line.
editor.title: Item
editor.fromList_projects: From your services and work items
editor.saveAsItem: Save as a product or service
editor.detailsPlaceholder:
Material: oak veneer
Fittings: soft-close hinges
editor.notePlaceholder: e.g. Marble price to be added after the customer picks it
editor.pictureInvalid: Pick a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture of up to 10 MB.
editor.pictureHint: Every picture prints the same size. Adjust chooses the part that shows.

crop.title: Adjust the picture
crop.description: Drag the picture and zoom to choose what shows in its frame. Every picture prints in this same frame.
crop.how: Drag to move it. Pinch, scroll or use the slider to zoom.
crop.preview: As it prints on the quotation
crop.cantOpen: This picture can't be opened here. Pick it again.
crop.savedNote: This picture is saved in its frame, so what was cut off can't come back. Zoom in and drag to choose a part of it, or pick it again to choose another part.

areas.addLineNoArea: Add a line without an area
areas.dialogHint: Its name is printed down the side of its lines on the PDF.
areas.lineToNone: Line {{number}} is now without an area.

errors.exists: There is already an area with this name.

editor.addDiscount: Add a discount on the whole quotation
editor.roundHint: Type the total you want, with VAT (for example 15,000). BizCost works out the change before VAT.
editor.roundStale: The lines changed after you rounded the total, so the rounding adjustment is now {{amount}}. Keep the rounded total, or take the rounding off to charge the lines as they are.
editor.roundCarried: This total was rounded on the revision before, and its rounding adjustment is now {{amount}}. Keep the rounded total, or take the rounding off to charge the lines as they are.
editor.roundCarriedCopy: This total was rounded on the quotation it was copied from, and its rounding adjustment is now {{amount}}. Keep the rounded total, or take the rounding off to charge the lines as they are.
editor.roundStaleHint: The total stays rounded: check the totals
editor.stagesHint: When the customer pays, and how much of the total each time.
editor.wordsHint: Printed above and below the lines. Leave a box empty to use the usual words.
editor.introPlaceholder: Thank you for your interest in our services. We are pleased to submit the following quotation for your review.
editor.termsPlaceholder: e.g. Prices include supply and installation.
editor.termsPlaceholderNew: Leave empty to use your usual terms (Settings → Documents).
editor.notesPlaceholder: Anything else the customer should know
editor.conflict: Someone else changed this quotation. Open it again to see the latest version.

errors.validBefore: "Valid until" can't be before the quotation's date.
errors.title: Type what this line is.
errors.productGone: This product or service was removed. Type the line again.
errors.due: Say when this payment is due.
errors.discountOverLine: The discount is more than this line.
errors.discountOver100: A discount can't be more than 100%.
errors.discountOverLines: The discount is more than the lines.
errors.discountMixed: Some prices include VAT and some don't. Give the discount as a %.
errors.roundUnreachable: This total can't be reached. Try a number closer to the total.
errors.stagesNot100: The payments must add up to 100%.

view.title: Quotation {{number}}
view.draftNote: This is a draft: the customer hasn't seen it. Send it when it's ready.
view.expiredNote: This quotation was valid until {{date}}. The customer can still accept it.
view.notFoundBody: It may have been discarded, or it belongs to a branch you don't work in.

pdf.title: Quotation PDF
pdf.draftNote: A draft's PDF says "Draft" on every page.
pdf.sendNote: Download the PDF, or share it with WhatsApp or a mail app.
pdf.shareFailed: The PDF couldn't be shared. Download it instead.

confirm.sendBody: Once sent, this revision can't be changed. To change it later, make a new revision.
confirm.sendNote: Then download the PDF or share it with the customer.
confirm.acceptBody: Record that the customer accepted this quotation.
confirm.acceptNote: You can then make an order from it.
confirm.signedHint: A PDF or a photo of the quotation the customer signed.
confirm.declineBody: Record that the customer declined this quotation. You can still revise it or copy it later.
confirm.reviseBody: Revision {{revision}} stays as it was sent. The new one opens as a draft for you to change.
confirm.reviseNote: Once you send the new revision, it replaces this one.
confirm.reviseAccepted: For extra work: the customer accepts the new revision again.
confirm.revised: Revision {{revision}} of {{number}} is ready to change.
confirm.copyBody: A new quotation with its own number, dated today, with the same lines. Pick its customer.
confirm.orderBody: An order for {{amount}} waits for delivery, with the same customer and lines.
confirm.orderNote: Nothing counts as a sale until the order is delivered.
confirm.discardBody: The draft and its pictures are removed. Its number isn't used again.

files.title: Files
files.hint: The customer's signed copy, drawings or photos.
files.afterSave: Save the quotation first, then attach files.
